item.title: Jamba: 50% Off FIFA World Cup Hat Trick Tango Smoothie
item.guid: Jamba-50% Off FIFA World Cup Hat Trick Tango S-2026-07-28
item.description: Order the limited-time Hat Trick Tango smoothie in the app and get 50% off this World Cup-inspired blend while the promotion lasts. (Limited time)

item.title: Tropical Smoothie Cafe: Last Day: How Far You'll Mango Disney Moana Smoothie
item.guid: Tropical Smoothie Cafe-Last Day: How Far You'll Mango Disne-2026-07-28
item.description: Today is the final day to order the limited-time How Far You'll Mango smoothie — a mango, pineapple, and guava blend inspired by Disney's live-action Moana, available in 24 oz regular or 12 oz kids size with a collectible sticker pack while supplies last. (Through July 28, 2026)

item.title: Wingstop: National Wing Day: 5 Free Bone-In Wings with $10+ Purchase (Code FREEWINGS, July 29)

item.description: Starting tomorrow July 29 for National Chicken Wing Day, use promo code FREEWINGS at checkout online or in the app with any qualifying $10 or more purchase to get 5 free classic bone-in wings. (Through July 29, 2026)

item.title: Popeyes: $5 Faves Menu

item.description: Get a $5 Your Way Meal — a burger or sandwich, small fries, and a small drink — every day at participating Burger King locations, no app required. (Ongoing)

item.title: McDonald's: $5 Value Meal Box

item.title: Denny's: Slammin' Meal Deals from $5.99

item.title: Subway: Footlong for $5.99 with Code FL599
item.description: Use promo code FL599 in the Subway app or online to get any Footlong sub for $5.99 — availability varies by zip code. (Limited time)

item.description: Chipotle is waiving the delivery fee on digital orders of $10 or more for a limited time. Order in the app or at chipotle.com - no code needed, open to everyone. (Limited time)

item.title: Sweetgreen: Alice Waters' Peach & Goat Cheese Salad
item.description: Limited-edition summer collab with chef Alice Waters - a seasonal peach & goat cheese salad available nationwide in-app and in stores, with 1% of proceeds donated to the Edible Schoolyard Project. (Through August 10, 2026)
